第一章 穿越而来-《末世入侵：我在副本里面当NPC》

上一章

存书签

下一章

爻雪穿越了，没有任何征兆，一觉醒来，她就发现自己竟然穿越了。

躺在豪华柔软的大床上，爻雪的脑海中不断地冒出一些既陌生又熟悉的记忆。

在看这些记忆时，她并没有以第三者的视角去看，那记忆里面的一件件事情，就仿佛是真的在她的身上发生过一样。

最重要的是，原主跟她同名同姓，甚至连年纪，生日都是一样的，如果不是她确认自己真的是穿越了，她都要以为自己是不是脑子出问题了。

也因为这些原因，目前爻雪对自己的穿越接受十分的良好，主要是她在之前的那个世界也没什么牵挂了，有颜有钱，父母双亡，典型的小说主角模板。

“要是再来一个系统那就完美了。”

爻雪这样想着，突然耳边响起一道‘滋滋’的电子音。

“系统？”

听到这有些陌生的声音，爻雪非但没有害怕，反而是眼神中充满了兴奋的神色。

虽然这个世界的她已经能够躺平十辈子了，但是谁又会介意自己多出一个系统呢，对不对。

这样想着，爻雪开始期待电子音接下来的动作。

下一秒，系统的电子音并没有出现，取而代之的是一个暗黑色的半透明面板。

Yaoxue traveled through time without any warning. When she woke up, she found that she had actually traveled through time.

Lying on the luxurious and soft bed, some strange and familiar memories kept popping up in Yaoxue's mind.

When she looked at these memories, she did not look at them from a third-party perspective. Everything in the memories seemed to have really happened to her.

The most important thing is that the original owner has the same name as her, and they even have the same age and birthday. If she hadn't confirmed that she had really traveled through time, she would have thought that there was something wrong with her brain.

Because of these reasons, Yaoxue currently accepts her time travel very well, mainly because she has no worries in the previous world. She is beautiful and rich, her parents are dead, and she is a typical novel protagonist template.

"It would be perfect if there was another system."

Yaoxue thought like this, and suddenly a "sizzling" electronic sound sounded in her ears.

"System?"

Hearing this somewhat unfamiliar voice, Yaoxue was not afraid, but her eyes were full of excitement.

Although she has been able to live peacefully in this world for ten lifetimes, who would mind having one more system, right?

Thinking like this, Yaoxue began to look forward to Electronic Sound's next move.

The next second, the electronic sound of the system did not appear, but was replaced by a dark black translucent panel.
